rows.name: no activation transaction exists in the outbox while the archive is down
archive UP but no signature of kind 3 for owner5: still withheld (NO_VALID_RECORD), still Probation, nothing in the outbox
a record of the WRONG kind (2, lottery winner) is accepted by the archive but does not activate the founder (kind 3 is required)
owner5 signs kind 3 (founder) and the archive accepts it
the Verifier service activated owner5 (recordActivation signed by SurKMS, sent by the service): status Active
QBFT validator set grew to 5 (op5 included)
the outbox row of the activation is confirmed; the decision is recorded

the decision is indexed with an evidence package sealed at >= 2 custodians and the on-chain StatusDecisionRecorded carries the same evidence hash (the sealed content, which includes the archive record, is not decrypted here)
